operation.summary: Who checks a photo sent with POST /v1/portal/photo: each agent (usually an installed applet) with a watch that checks photos, and the owner's last pick on the phone's Camera tab. For the owner's Bridgit app on iPhone & iPad, over the relay; read-only.
